proposal.objective: Extend the existing payment hardening PR with a product-owned transactional PostgreSQL inbox, bounded recovery and audited replay; no production activation

criteria: Only authenticated, trusted-scope normalized events are accepted durably; duplicate identity cannot change tenant or payload
Transactional domain effects and the processed marker commit together; failures roll back and retry is bounded
Dead-letter replay is audited/idempotent and cannot erase attempt history
File-backed PostgreSQL SQL tests cover duplicate delivery, rollback, restart, ambiguous commit, scope isolation and data allowlisting
Package contains the explicit EXPAND migration; no DDL runs at startup; existing Mercado Pago and TS/Python tests pass
Declare independent-process PostgreSQL contention, reconciliation and ledger consumer acceptance pending; no production or sandbox claim

capabilities.name: payments
capabilities.reason: Existing canonical owner includes inbox/idempotency; no new central service
